descriptive.detail: not scored: the fixed covariates are the H-G hypothesis, so the residual between-family share is not a fair test of H-B

descriptive.quantity: top-tuple Jaccard, Gaussian vs Gaussian-copula (descriptive only)
descriptive.detail: 8 models over 31 ensemble cells, min per-model 0.67. Withdrawn as an H-B criterion by the 2026-08-06 audit (M6): both rankings come from Gaussian estimators on the SAME samples -- the copula transform only removes marginal non-Gaussianity -- so agreement between them measures estimator similarity, not module stability. Stability across independent samples is what blueprint 19.3 asks for and what the campaign-scramble replicate now supplies.

descriptive.quantity: statistical synergy modules validated by direct perturbation (NOT EVALUABLE)
descriptive.detail: n_top=36, n_control=36; supported 0.361 vs control 0.083; scope: NOT EVALUABLE -- the stored battery was produced under measurement schema not recorded, the campaign is now probe-3; its backgrounds and candidate tuples are derived from feature rows that have since been regenerated. Withheld from the tally: functional support is computed from the same eta as the contrast below, so it inherits the same numerical precondition. Not evaluable is not the same as failed.

descriptive.quantity: top-synergy tuples more non-additive than matched controls (NOT EVALUABLE)
descriptive.detail: top=0.331 SD vs control=0.119 SD (ratio 2.78x); paired difference +0.158 SD, lineage-clustered 95% CI [-0.002, +0.442] over 4 lineages; scope: NOT EVALUABLE -- the stored battery was produced under measurement schema not recorded, the campaign is now probe-3; its backgrounds and candidate tuples are derived from feature rows that have since been regenerated. Withheld from the tally: the campaign-dt eta this contrast is built from does not satisfy the half-step repeatability rule prespecified in perturbation_inference.py. The rule is preregistered; the decision to withhold on it is not -- see perturbation_precondition.provenance.

descriptive.quantity: top vs random control point ratio (descriptive only)
descriptive.detail: top=0.331 SD vs control=0.074 SD (ratio 4.50x); paired difference +0.205 SD, lineage-clustered 95% CI [+0.023, +0.515] over 4 lineages; scope: NOT EVALUABLE -- the stored battery was produced under measurement schema not recorded, the campaign is now probe-3; its backgrounds and candidate tuples are derived from feature rows that have since been regenerated. Not scored: same measurement as the criterion above with a different denominator.

perturbation_precondition.rule: perturbation-derived H-B criteria are scored only on implementations whose per-background eta is numerically repeatable at half the campaign time step
perturbation_precondition.provenance: added 2026-08-09 in response to the independent post-response audit, with the 2/5 repeatability outcome already known. The repeatability RULE it consumes was prespecified in perturbation_inference.py before the half-step run; the minimum lineage count is new and is set by what a clustered bootstrap can estimate.
perturbation_precondition.definition: per-background eta recomputed at half the campaign dt; repeatable = median |delta eta| <= 0.05 feature SD AND >= 80% of tuple means keep their sign
perturbation_precondition.reason: the stored battery was produced under measurement schema not recorded, the campaign is now probe-3; its backgrounds and candidate tuples are derived from feature rows that have since been regenerated

conclusion: H-G 3/5; H-B NOT EVALUABLE -- no computable criterion in this arm (both H-B criteria are perturbation-derived and were withheld: the stored battery was produced under measurement schema not recorded, the campaign is now probe-3; its backgrounds and candidate tuples are derived from feature rows that have since been regenerated). The causal-module question is UNRESOLVED, not answered in the negative; no H-M or H-G label is asserted.
